name: Craftsman's Writ: Practice Lock
summary: A transferable writ asks you to provide one Practice Lock. Its delivery location and payment terms are marked on the note.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A customer requests one Practice Lock through a faded, transferable writ. You are asked to deliver the requested item to the location marked on your map, with the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.answer: The writ requests one Practice Lock.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the Practice Lock?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
Yes. The writ says it is transferable.
The writ mentions payment, but gives no amount in the provided text.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Practice Lock
